EVALUATION AND DISPOSITION
1. Cook County Highway Department
We have reviewed your Draft Environ-
mental Statement-Section 4(f) for the
proposed subject improvement in its
relationship to the National Environ-
mental Policy Act of 1969 and find that
your proposed design and research sum-
mary adhere to the policies required\nin Cook County.

We therefore concur with your proposed\nimprovement along Lincoln Highway.
Concur
2. Village of Park Forest
A. Widening of the roadway will bring vehicular traffic closer to single-family residences located within the Village of Park Forest which border upon Lincoln Highway. This will have two effects: First of all, there will be an increase in noise pollution; secondly, unless corrective steps are taken soon we will lose a well established screen planting which was developed for the purpose of separating the single-family residences from Lincoln Highway traffic.
A. Noise pollution is discussed in Chapter III in accordance with PPM 90-2. Concur on the corrective steps required to replant the screen planting for the purpose of separating the residential area.
